name: Agugliano (Italy)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Agugliano (a white needle on blue above a green mount) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Agugliano, a comune in Marche; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Agugliano arms — white needle on blue above a green mount, crowned, within branches
